# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the change and the user or maintenance problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Customer frontend (`Client/`)
- [ ] Admin frontend (`Client/react/`)
- [ ] Backend (`Server/`)
- [ ] Documentation or repository tooling

## Implementation

Explain the approach and any important design decisions.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant build completed.
- [ ] Relevant tests completed.
- [ ] Manual verification completed where automated coverage is unavailable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data were added.
- [ ] Existing third-party license notices were preserved.

List exact commands and outcomes. Do not claim checks passed if they were not run.

## Security and privacy

Describe authorization, validation, data handling, upload, payment, or dependency implications. State "No material impact" only after reviewing the change.

## Accessibility

Describe keyboard, focus, semantic markup, contrast, responsive, and assistive-technology considerations.

## Documentation and compatibility

- [ ] Documentation updated.
- [ ] Configuration changes documented.
- [ ] API or data-model changes documented.
- [ ] Migration or rollback considerations documented.
